# Changelog

<!-- Generated by build.js from docs/prism-development/changes/. Do not edit; add a fragment there instead. -->

Summaries of Prism CLI releases, newest first. Versions correspond to `prism-cli-v*` git tags. **Bold** items are significant or need your attention; plain items are background changes.

## v1.15.0 (12-Nov-2026)

- Prism's skills and instructions refer to Prism's own files as `<PRISM_ROOT>/...`, defined in Prism's agent instructions, so the same text works when Prism runs as a Claude Code plugin. Links to your own files (overrides, configuration) are unchanged in effect.
- **Spec Kit's files are an exact copy of Spec Kit 1.0.4**: `prism update` refreshes them, so the phase scripts accept every option the skills pass, such as `-RequireSpec`. Leftovers from older Spec Kit releases are removed, including `create-new-feature.ps1`, which Spec Kit now names `create-new-feature-branch.ps1`, and `update-agent-context.ps1`, now part of the `agent-context` extension. If your own scripts call either by name, switch to the new ones.
- Prism's conduct rules no longer ban em and en dashes. The rule added little and cluttered agents' writing, especially plans. Agents can use them again; to keep the ban, add it to `.prism/instructions/overrides/agent-conduct.instructions.md`.
- Prism's install record moves from `.specify/integrations/prism.manifest.json` to `.prism/prism.manifest.json`, and records which route the project uses. The next `prism init` or `prism update` moves it.
- When `prism update` writes Spec Kit's files, it now also updates the Spec Kit version in `.specify/init-options.json` and `.specify/integration.json`, and changes nothing else in them.
- `.specify/extensions/agent-context/agent-context-config.yml` is now yours: it's seeded once and `prism update` no longer overwrites it.
- New `prism init --plugin` and `prism update --plugin` set up and refresh a project that gets Prism from the Prism plugin for Claude Code. Prism's setup agent runs them for you.
- New guide, `docs/prism/install/routes.md`: compares installing Prism with the CLI and with the Prism plugin for Claude Code, and covers setting up a project with the plugin or moving an existing one to it.
- Setup guide corrections: fill in the `.prism/config/repos.yml` that Prism creates (using `repos.yml.sample` as an example) rather than copying the sample, and the template overrides folder now holds a README from Prism.
- **`prism update` now names hand-edited Prism files before it changes them**: each is marked overwritten or removed, and the update then carries on. `prism status` lists them beforehand. Move any change you want to keep into your override files first.
- The override files Prism seeds in `.prism/instructions/overrides/` now name the skill or rules they extend instead of linking to Prism's files, so the links work however Prism is installed. Files you already have are unchanged.
- Prism's spec, plan and tasks templates now live in `.prism/templates/` and are refreshed by `prism update`. Prism's SDD phases use your template in `.specify/templates/overrides/` if there is one, then Prism's, then Spec Kit's base template. New installs no longer seed copies into `.specify/templates/overrides/`. Copies an earlier install seeded there still take precedence, so delete any you haven't changed to pick up Prism's current templates.
- **The Nintex constitution and standards are now Prism's**: `prism update` keeps `.specify/memory/constitution.md` and `.specify/memory/standards/` at their current versions. The first update to this release replaces your copies, naming any that differ from Prism's first. Add your team's own standards through `AGENTS.md` instead.
- **The constitution-authoring tools are removed**: `speckit-constitution`, with its Copilot agent and prompt `speckit.constitution`, and Spec Kit's constitution template. Prism owns the constitution, so nothing it ships writes one. `prism update` removes them; a copy of the template in `.specify/templates/overrides/` stays, unused.
- **`ci-triage` is removed from Prism**: it's a team skill rather than part of Prism. `prism update` removes `.claude/skills/ci-triage/`; your `.prism/config/skills/ci-triage/registry.yaml` stays. To keep using the skill, restore its folder from git after updating: Prism then leaves it alone as your team's own.
- **Copilot**: a new `create-ado-work-item` agent, which `prism-tasks` offers as a "Create Work Items" handoff. The `generate-context-prism` prompt now runs in Copilot's agent mode: it named a custom agent that doesn't exist. Prism's Copilot agents and prompts, and a new `.github/instructions/prism-paths.instructions.md`, say where Prism's files are, so the skills they hand off to find them directly.
- **Prism is available as a plugin for Claude Code**, `prism@nintex-skills`: all of Prism as `/prism:` commands, such as `/prism:specify`, kept current by Claude Code with nothing to update in the repository. Prism's setup agent, `/prism:setup`, sets a project up with the plugin or moves an existing project to it, and `/prism:about` says which Prism build is active. Each session starts with a report of the active release, and warnings when something needs fixing, such as Prism installed twice. See `docs/prism/install/routes.md`, and `docs/prism/install/troubleshooting.md` for the warnings. The CLI is unchanged, and Copilot keeps using it.

## v1.14.0 (20-Oct-2026)

- **`accessibility-wcag` and `nintex-localisation` moved** out of Prism into the `engineering-standards` plugin, so every Nintex team can use them. `prism update` removes Prism's old copies. In Claude Code the plugin replaces them automatically; GitHub Copilot users should install them with `npx @nintex/skills --skill accessibility-wcag nintex-localisation --agent github-copilot`.
- **Nintex skills marketplace**: `prism init` and `prism update` now register the shared [Nintex skills marketplace](https://github.com/NintexGlobal/rnd-nintex-skills) in `.claude/settings.json` and enable its `engineering-standards` plugin. Existing settings are kept; Prism only adds missing entries. Team members need GitHub read access to the marketplace repo (see setup S4).

## v1.12.0 (16-Oct-2026)

- **Prism's agent instructions moved out of `AGENTS.md`** into the managed `.prism/instructions/prism-agents.instructions.md`, so everything in your `AGENTS.md` is now yours.
- **Prism less invasive in code repo AGENTS.md**: `generate-context-repo` skill now injects a single, minimal reference in the target repo's `AGENTS.md` to link to the `.context/manifest.yml` created in that repo. It used to inject a lot more context links and consume too much token window with forced context loading.
- **Less mandatory code context**: `generate-context-repo` configured to mark less context files as `always-load`. Skill must be re-run to implement this, but you could ask it to just update the context root manifest to avoid a full repo scan.
- Prism dogfooding configuration to allow Prism process to be used to develop features in Prism itself without affecting the Prism CLI installer it creates.

## v1.11.0 (08-Oct-2026)

- **New Prism skills** - default to using `prism-specify`, `prism-plan` and `prism-tasks` instead of the old `speckit-*` skills.
  - `prism-specify` is similar to speckit-specify for now.
  - `prism-plan` generates a high-level architectural and interfaces technical plan rather than the highly detailed technical plan generated by `speckit-plan`.
  - `prism-tasks` generates a separate file per task and then an overall `tasks.md` broken into user stories that combine these tasks. Tasks can then be cleanly reviewed and implemented per-task or per user-story
  - **Prism skill overrides** - Added `/.prism/instructions/overrides/...` for team override instructions of prism-specify, prism-plan, prism-tasks and agent-conduct.

## v1.10.0 (02-Oct-2026)

- **`spec-grill-me` was renamed to `prism-grill-me`** - update any scripts, docs, or muscle memory referencing `/spec-grill-me`.
- **Skill configuration** - these new skills are user-configurable using the instruction files in `/.prism/instructions/overrides/`.
- **/generate-context-repo and /generate-context-prism updated** to create a much less detailed top-level code repo `manifest.yml`, and to improve the context injection prompt in the Prism repo `AGENTS.md` to not enforce loading the context if not required. Re-run these skills to apply these updates.

## v1.9.0 (18-Sep-2026)

- Tidy the roadmap.md
- Tidy the changelog.md

## v1.8.0 (14-Sep-2026)

- **Customisable branch and feature-folder naming** — new `.prism/config/branch-naming.yml`, lets a team define formats for feature branch, feature folder and task branch. Optional — edit the seeded file if your team wants a different format, or blank out branch formats to turn off automatic branch creation for that scope entirely.
- Clean-working-tree guard on `speckit-specify` — before creating a feature branch, the skill now also checks `git status --porcelain` and asks you to commit, stash, or discard pending changes if the tree isn't clean, in addition to the existing default-branch check.

## v1.7.0 (08-Sep-2026)

- **Don't update unchanged files on CLI update** (#29) — fixed the Prism CLI's `update` command overwriting every file on macOS during npm updates because line-ending differences (CRLF/LF) were being treated as content changes; file comparison now ignores line endings.
- Update Spec Kit to 1.0.4 (#30) — pulled in upstream Spec Kit 1.0.4 across all `speckit-*` skills and agent definitions (specify, plan, tasks, clarify, checklist, constitution, analyze, implement, converge, taskstoissues).

## v1.6.0 (04-Sep-2026)

- **Ensure `copilot-instructions.md` refers to AGENTS.md** (#25) — CLI init/update now patches an existing `copilot-instructions.md` to reference `AGENTS.md` if it doesn't already, so GitHub Copilot picks up the shared agent instructions even in repos that had a pre-existing Copilot config.

## v1.5.0 (25-Aug-2026)

- **`prism-clarify` was renamed to `spec-grill-me`** (#24) — update any scripts, docs, or muscle memory referencing `/prism-clarify`.
- **Add `ci-triage` skill** (#22) — added the `ci-triage` skill for triaging Azure DevOps pipeline/build failures (flaky tests, infra issues vs. product defects) for Nintex Tables, Files, and NWC Dashboard.
- Schema reference header for `repos.yml` (#19) — added a JSON schema reference header to `.prism/config/repos.yml` and refined the corresponding schema property descriptions.
- Prism roadmap, adoption, and learnings docs (#17) — restructured documentation: split out `docs/prism-development/` from `docs/prism/`, and added `roadmap.md`, `adoption.md`, and `learnings.md`.

## v1.0.0 – v1.4.0 (15-Jun-2026 to 16-Jul-2026)

- **Initial release of `@nintex/prism`** — CLI for installing and upgrading the Nintex Prism spec-driven development framework in any repo (`prism init`, `prism update`), publishing to the Nintex npm feed.
- Early stabilization fixes to the release pipeline and installation guide.
- Individual changes for v1.1.0–v1.4.0 predate this changelog's convention; see the `prism-cli-v1.1.0`..`prism-cli-v1.4.0` tags for commit-level detail.
